title: Praga Tools Corporation v. C.A. Imanual

content.caseIdentity: Praga Tools Corporation v. C.A. Imanual, (1969) 1 SCC 585
content.facts: The Court considered whether a public-sector corporation was amenable to writ jurisdiction.
questionsBeforeCourt: When can a public corporation be subjected to public-law remedies?
content.ratioDecidendi: A writ may issue where a public authority has a public duty; the precise remedy depends on the nature of the duty and statutory/public-law obligation.
content.holding: The Court explained the limits of writ relief against a company.
content.relevance: Use for public corporations and public-law accountability.
